direct_aorist.analysis: pra + ni + aṭ + mā + middle aorist; the author expressly allows ṇatva across the augment.
direct_aorist.attestation_scope: The same written form occurs on the māṅ route by construction, but this particular citation is entered only under meṅ.

perfect: Under 6.4.64 the ā of the reduplicated base drops before the relevant vowel-initial endings. Compare mame, mamāte, mamire and second singular mamiṣe in the root commentary. Both roots share the nine middle perfect forms in the fixed archive.
prefix_condition: The word-internal ṇ identifies the prefix environment, but after the four present-system lakāras neither it nor these inflectional surfaces identifies which of the two lexical roots was chosen.
